reason: I don't install .exe files from one unknown developer with no reviews or signing, and my small fast viewer already does what I need. Version 0.4.1 from a single person is exactly what I stay away from.
why_switch_or_not: I open photos my relatives send and sometimes print one. My current viewer does that fine, so I have no reason to take a security risk on a solo-dev app. The list of RAW, 3D, video and editor features means nothing to me, and I worry an app that does that much will want to take over my picture files and change how colours look when I print.
current_app_pros: Small, starts instantly, opens phone JPGs and screenshots, and doesn't get in my way. I know where everything is.
current_app_pains: Nothing really. Now and then a format won't open, but I almost never hit that.
objection: A solo developer's unsigned installer with no reviews or source I can check. Also, I don't want my colours or print output to change.
would_change_my_mind: A signed installer, open source I can read, or independent reviews from people I trust, plus a clear statement that it leaves my files and colours untouched.
